items.title: Hegseth Has Been 'Disaster' as Secretary of Defense, Says Rep. Stanton
items.summary: Democrat Representative from Arizona Greg Stanton said that he will vote yes to impeach Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and described the secretary's tenure as 'a disaster.' Stanton said that while Democrats are looking to lower costs for the American people, the  party also promised midterm voters to 'reestablish checks and balances' in government and this impeachment is in line with that plan. Stanton, who sits on the House China Select Committee, also discussed probes in Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and said that lawmakers need a classified briefing as soon as possible about what the intelligence community knows about the Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
